item.title: Google Cloud Launches AI-powered Agents to Simplify Database Lifecycle Management
item.description: Google Cloud has introduced AI-powered Database Operations Agents, featuring an Onboarding Agent that streamlines database setup and an Observability Agent that helps automate troubleshooting, performance optimization, and tuning. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Read Your Writes: WAIT FOR in Postgres 19
item.description: PostgreSQL 19's new `WAIT FOR` command enables read-your-writes consistency on asynchronous replicas by letting individual reads wait for a specific WAL position. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Looking Forward to Postgres 19: Syntax Potpourri
item.description: Shaun Thomas discusses ON CONFLICT DO SELECT, GROUP BY ALL, COPY JSON: three Postgres 19 syntax additions that fix things you've been quietly working around for years. (1 source: postgresweekly)
